notes.backstory:
Octavian is part of a large family of farmers, but never saw himself as a farmer. Then one day, he came upon an old journal, that belonged to an unknown ancestor (possibly Olanthius), which described a great adventure to the depths of hell itself as part of a group known as the Hellriders. From that day on, Octavian become obsessed with learning more about the group, and swore to join them at the first opportunity. The day he turned 17 and was allowed to leave the farm was that opportunity!

In his travels, Octavian keeps the journal on him at all times and reads it in secret whenever possible. He refuses to discuss the contents of the book.

Then one day, he came upon an old journal, that belonged to an unknown ancestor (possibly Olanthius), which described a great adventure to the depths of hell itself as part of a group known as the Hellriders. From that day on, Octavian become obsessed with learning more about the group, and swore to join them at the first opportunity. The day he turned 17 and was allowed to leave the farm was that opportunity!

In his travels, Octavian keeps the journal on him at all times and reads it in secret whenever possible. He refuses to discuss the contents of the book.

background.name: Farmer
background.description:
Ability Scores: Strength, Constitution, Wisdom
Feat: Tough
Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling and Nature
Tool Proficiency: Carpenter's Tools
Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Sickle, Carpenter's Tools, Healer's Kit, Iron Pot, Shovel, Traveler's Clothes, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

You grew up close to the land. Years tending animals and cultivating the earth rewarded you with patience and good health. You have a keen appreciation for nature’s bounty alongside a healthy respect for nature’s wrath.
